'''Wine''' can refer to the following:

* ''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 39|A Cup of Wine]]'' - the thirty-ninth chapter of ''[[The Shadow Rising]]''.
* The [[Wine Riots]] - an event that happened in the [[Rahad]], part of [[Ebou Dar]].
* The [[Winespring Inn]] - an inn in Emond's Field.
* The [[Winespring]] - a natural aquifier in [[Emond's Field]].
* The [[Winespring Water]] - a creek in Emond's Field.

==See also==
* The [[Garden of Silver Breezes]] - a wineshop.
* [[Comolad]] - an exquisite of wine from the [[Age of Legends]].
* [[Satare]] - a delicate wine from the Age of Legends.
